name: Value-first Pro subscription
free_value: Unlimited local capture; text and Share entry; deterministic recovery; owned-thread read edit export delete; generic proven lock entry; remotely configured cloud sample
paid_value: Sustained cloud transcription and grounded AI recovery for ordinary personal use
price_hypothesis: US$4.99 monthly; US$39.99 annual; seven cloud drafts per rolling 30 days as a remotely configured free-boundary hypothesis
revenuecat_shape: One pro entitlement; default Offering; monthly and annual packages; store-specific products mapped to equivalent packages
paywall_trigger: Dismissible offer after first verified start; blocking offer only before a new cloud request beyond free allowance
unit_cost_exposure: Recurring provider cost; illustrative bounded call is below one cent before retries infrastructure and support
restore_and_expiry: User-triggered restore; Pro remains through active entitlement and grace; expiry closes only recurring cloud value; owned data stays available
fairness_and_accessibility: Visible free alternative and dismiss; actual annual charge prominent; no shame copy countdown or preselected consent; all controls screen-reader and large-text compatible
primary_award_evidence: Post-value paywall uses Forward Thread grammar and demonstrates offer purchase entitlement restore billing and expiry inside the same thread
main_risk: Unvalidated recurrence and willingness to pay; cloud allowance may feel stingy or too generous
reason: Best alignment between sustained value recurring cost trust and solo implementation

name: First-success subscription with long annual trial
free_value: One complete verified restart and local deterministic fallback
paid_value: Further cloud recovery during and after paid access
purchase_mix: Monthly and annual subscription with a long annual trial
price_hypothesis: Use M1 price anchors until tested
trial_or_intro: Trial duration tested inside the observed 17–32-day RevenueCat benchmark range
revenuecat_shape: One pro entitlement; trial-bearing annual package; non-trial monthly package
paywall_trigger: After first verified start; subsequent AI recovery requires trial or purchase
unit_cost_exposure: Provider cost during trial and cancellation support
restore_and_expiry: Same restore and expiry rules as M1
fairness_and_accessibility: Clear auto-renewal price duration cancel and free fallback; no trial emphasis over actual charge
primary_award_evidence: Shows a complete first-value-to-trial lifecycle and transparent trial end
main_risk: Pressure after a vulnerable moment; user may not experience recurrence during trial
reason: Consider only if repeated value is real and M1 conversion cannot cover cost

name: Lifetime local unlock plus consumable recovery packs
paid_value: Lifetime local extras plus metered cloud recovery credits
purchase_mix: Non-consumable lifetime purchase and consumable packs
price_hypothesis: Do not set pack sizes or prices before measured cost and use frequency
revenuecat_shape: Lifetime entitlement plus consumables not attached to permanent entitlement; custom user identity required for reliable recovery
paywall_trigger: At credit depletion before cloud processing
unit_cost_exposure: Direct cost is bounded but balance fraud refund and support expand
restore_and_expiry: Consumables and non-renewing purchases require account-backed recovery; anonymous consumed Google purchases may not restore
fairness_and_accessibility: Avoids recurring billing but creates metering anxiety in the highest-friction moment
primary_award_evidence: Could show clear discrete value but fragments the recovery flow into a store transaction
main_risk: Balance accounting identity restore failure and purchase pressure during interruption
reason: Discrete-payment fit is outweighed by UX and operational complexity
